fomod.Name: LipSync Together (Voice Lip Sync)
fomod.Author: mailamea10
fomod.Description: Lip sync and optional proximity voice chat for Skyrim Together Reborn. Includes secure session-key and open voice relay choices. Supports the official Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.4 from Nexus on Skyrim 1.7.104 and 1.6.1170/1.6.1179. Requires Mfg Fix NG or Mfg Fix; neither is included.
